import AlgebraicJacobian.Picard.QuotScheme

/-!+# Quasi-coherence from affine pullbacks

Presentations on the affine-open cover descend through the geometric and
slice restriction equivalence. This criterion assembles the affine kernel
and cokernel constructions used by the universal divisor candidate.
-/

noncomputable section

set_option autoImplicit false

open CategoryTheory CategoryTheory.Limits TopologicalSpace

universe u

namespace AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules

set_option maxHeartbeats 1600000 in
-- Transporting presentations between the geometric and slice sites needs this headroom.
set_option synthInstance.maxHeartbeats 800000 in
/-- Quasi-coherence can be checked after pullback to every affine open. -/
theorem isQuasicoherent_of_affine_pullback {X : Scheme.{u}} (M : X.Modules)
    (h : ∀ U : X.affineOpens,
      ((pullback U.2.fromSpec).obj M).IsQuasicoherent) : M.IsQuasicoherent := by
  haveI : ∀ U : X.affineOpens, (M.over U.1).IsQuasicoherent := by
    intro U
    let N := (pullback U.2.fromSpec).obj M
    haveI : N.IsQuasicoherent := h U
    haveI hN : IsIso N.fromTildeΓ := isIso_fromTildeΓ_of_isQuasicoherent N
    let eN := @asIso _ _ _ _ N.fromTildeΓ hN
    let P : N.Presentation :=
      SheafOfModules.Presentation.ofIsIso.{u} eN.hom
        (AlgebraicGeometry.presentationTilde.{u} _ Set.univ (by simp) _
          (Submodule.span_eq _))
    have hcomp : U.2.isoSpec.hom ≫ U.2.fromSpec = U.1.ι := by
      rw [← U.2.isoSpec_inv_ι, Iso.hom_inv_id_assoc]
    let P' : ((pullback U.1.ι).obj M).Presentation :=
      SheafOfModules.Presentation.ofIsIso.{u, u, u}
        ((pullbackComp U.2.isoSpec.hom U.2.fromSpec).app M ≪≫
          (pullbackCongr hcomp).app M).hom
        (presentationPullbackOfSchemeIso U.2.isoSpec.symm N P)
    exact (overRestrictPresentationInv U.1 M P').isQuasicoherent
  apply SheafOfModules.IsQuasicoherent.of_coversTop M (fun U : X.affineOpens => U.1)
  intro W x hx
  obtain ⟨V, hV, hxV, hVW⟩ :=
    Opens.isBasis_iff_nbhd.mp (Scheme.isBasis_affineOpens X) hx
  refine ⟨V, homOfLE hVW, ?_, hxV⟩
  rw [Sieve.mem_ofObjects_iff]
  exact ⟨⟨V, hV⟩, ⟨𝟙 V⟩⟩

end AlgebraicGeometry.Scheme.Modules
